name: Justice Android Laboratory
backstory: A heavy android and a mobile synthetic form an arena partnership across very different origins. Balanced investment gives both machines useful work in the same two-frame account.
strategy_personality: A new android-themed concept would differ substantially from Metal Men's material-based bodies. Select a specific source design, especially for Amazo. [DC reference](https://www.dc.com/comics/justice-league-of-america-2006/justice-league-of-america-22). The pair is an Armoured Souls arena collection. Final source editions and individual build roles remain to be selected.

robots.name: Amazo
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: Authentic golden Amazo from Justice League Unlimited 2004, adult humanoid android with tall athletic entirely gold body, bald gold head, pointed ears, angular humanlike face and small pale eyes. Smooth source body construction with restrained fine mechanical seams, gold torso/limbs and complete gold feet. No clothing added, no human skin or sexual anatomy, no giant armour or copied superhero logos, neutral still pose.
Metadata only, do not render text: #158 slot 1 Amazo.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Amazo fills the heavy mid-range pressure role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Bruiser tuning supports the mid equipment role; offensive stance and a 10% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Duo strategy tuning rules with the Bruiser Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

purchasing_plan: Open with both robots. Alternate stage-1 equipment investment between slots 1 and 2; finish both final loadouts before refining. Visit both robots in each Hone pass, then each Augment pass, buying Workshop L1/L3 only as required. No Sharpen or Forge purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
